newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian trade team meets Saudi commerce minister to discuss ways of boosting economic, commercial and investment cooperation between the two countries.
- Saudi launches programme to help small-scale investors in Riyadh.
- The Saudi and Sri Lankan governments examine ways to bring telephone tariffs for calls to Sri Lanka in line with rates for India, Pakistan and Bangladesh.
- Five uranium sites found in Saudi Arabia, official says.
- Saudi industry and electricity minister approved 86 industrial projects in the kingdom worth 1.3 billion riyals last month.
- Saudi officials forecast that passengers using King Abdul-Aziz airport in Jeddah will reach 10 million a year by the end of the century.
